ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) pre-encryption staging: 7-Zip archive of file shares chained to MEGAsync / rclone exfil
ucs.description: Hunts the textbook INC Ransom double-extortion playbook: stage data from network shares or staging paths (C:\Users\Public, C:\ProgramData, C:\Windows\Temp) into a 7-Zip/WinRAR archive, then exfiltrate via MEGAsync, MEGAcmd or rclone in the minutes before .INC ransomware deployment. Correlation on same host + same user within 60 minutes weeds out benign WinRAR/MEGA use.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as stage_first max(_time) as stage_last from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("7z.exe","7za.exe","WinRAR.exe","Rar.exe") (Processes.process="* a *" OR Processes.process="* a -*") (Processes.process="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\\\*" OR Processes.process="*.7z*" OR Processes.process="*.rar*" OR Processes.process="*.zip*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process as archive_cmd process_name as archive_bin | join type=inner dest user [ | tstats summariesonly=t count as exfil_count min(_time) as exfil_first max(_time) as exfil_last from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("MEGAsync.exe","MEGAcmd.exe","MEGAclient.exe","megacmdserver.exe","rclone.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process as exfil_cmd process_name as exfil_bin ] | eval delay_sec=exfil_first-stage_first | where delay_sec>=0 AND delay_sec<=3600 | table stage_first, exfil_first, delay_sec, dest, user, archive_bin, archive_cmd, exfil_bin, exfil_cmd | sort - stage_first
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowMin = 60m;
let StagingArchives = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("7z.exe","7za.exe","WinRAR.exe","Rar.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (" a "," a -","-mx","-mhe","-v")     // archive verb / volume / encryption flags INC operators use
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".7z",".rar",".zip",@"\\",@"\Users\Public\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\Windows\Temp\",@"\Temp\")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project StageTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ArchiveBin = FileName, ArchiveCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let ExfilProcess = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("MEGAsync.exe","MEGAcmd.exe","MEGAclient.exe","megacmdserver.exe","rclone.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ExfilTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ExfilBin = FileName, ExfilCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let ExfilNet = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","g.api.mega.co.nz","gfs.mega.nz")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe")     // exclude browser visits to mega.nz
    | project ExfilTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName, ExfilBin = InitiatingProcessFileName, ExfilCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let Exfil = union ExfilProcess, ExfilNet;
StagingArchives
| join kind=inner Exfil on DeviceId, AccountName
| where ExfilTime between (StageTime .. StageTime + WindowMin)
| project StageTime, ExfilTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ExfilTime, StageTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, ArchiveBin, ArchiveCmd, ExfilBin, ExfilCmd
| summarize StageCmd = any(ArchiveCmd), ExfilCmd = any(ExfilCmd), Stages = dcount(ArchiveCmd), Exfils = dcount(ExfilCmd)
            by bin(StageTime, 1h), DeviceName, AccountName, ArchiveBin, ExfilBin
| order by StageTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowMin = 60m;
let Stage = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any (@"\7z.exe",@"\7za.exe",@"\WinRAR.exe",@"\Rar.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any (" a "," a -","-mx","-mhe","-v")
    | where CommandLine has_any (".7z",".rar",".zip",@"\\",@"\Users\Public\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\Windows\Temp\",@"\Temp\")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
    | project StageTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ArchiveCmd = CommandLine, ArchiveBin = NewProcessName;
let Exfil = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any (@"\MEGAsync.exe",@"\MEGAcmd.exe",@"\MEGAclient.exe",@"\megacmdserver.exe",@"\rclone.exe")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ExfilTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ExfilCmd = CommandLine, ExfilBin = NewProcessName;
Stage
| join kind=inner Exfil on Computer, SubjectUserName
| where ExfilTime between (StageTime .. StageTime + WindowMin)
| project StageTime, ExfilTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ExfilTime, StageTime),
          Computer, SubjectUserName, ArchiveBin, ArchiveCmd, ExfilBin, ExfilCmd
| order by StageTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: INC Ransom Cloud Exfiltration Tool Spawn (MEGA / rclone)
id: 9a7d4c8b-2f6e-4a1c-8d29-3f5a1b9c4e72
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects launch of MEGAsync / MEGAcmd / MEGAclient / rclone on Windows endpoints.
  These are the staple cloud-exfiltration utilities the INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) crew
  drops after staging file-share data into 7-Zip / WinRAR archives, immediately
  preceding deployment of the .INC encryptor.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032/
  - https://www.huntress.com/blog/investigating-new-inc-ransom-group-activity
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.g1032
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\MEGAsync.exe'
      - '\MEGAcmd.exe'
      - '\MEGAclient.exe'
      - '\megacmdserver.exe'
      - '\rclone.exe'
  selection_rclone_args:
    Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'copy'
      - 'sync'
      - 'mega:'
      - '--config'
  filter_install:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\setup.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/install'
      - '--version'
  condition: (selection_image and not filter_install) or selection_rclone_args
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned end-user MEGA cloud client (allowlist by AccountUpn or installation path)
  - Approved rclone backup jobs (allowlist by parent process / scheduled-task name)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\MEGAsync.exe OR *\megasync.exe OR *\MEGASYNC.EXE OR *\MEGAcmd.exe OR *\megacmd.exe OR *\MEGAClient.exe OR *\megaclient.exe OR *\megacmdserver.exe OR *\rclone.exe OR *\Rclone.exe OR *\RCLONE.EXE)) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(*.mega.nz OR *.mega.co.nz OR *.userstorage.mega.co.nz OR g.api.mega.co.nz) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\brave.exe))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(MEGAsync|MEGAcmd|MEGAclient|megacmdserver|rclone)\.exe$/i) OR (#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(7z|7za|WinRAR|Rar)\.exe$/i CommandLine=/\s+a(\s+-|\s+\")/i CommandLine=/(\.7z|\.rar|\.zip|\\Users\\Public\\|\\ProgramData\\|\\Windows\\Temp\\|\\\\)/i) OR (#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(^|\.)mega\.(nz|co\.nz)$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={
    archive_count := count(ImageFileName=/\\(7z|7za|WinRAR|Rar)\.exe$/i),
    exfil_count := count(ImageFileName=/\\(MEGAsync|MEGAcmd|MEGAclient|megacmdserver|rclone)\.exe$/i),
    mega_dns := count(#event_simpleName=DnsRequest),
    first := min(@timestamp),
    last := max(@timestamp),
    sample_archive := selectFromMin(field=@timestamp, include=[CommandLine]),
    sample_exfil := selectFromMax(field=@timestamp, include=[CommandLine])
  })
| (archive_count >= 1 AND (exfil_count >= 1 OR mega_dns >= 1))
| span := last - first
| span < 3600000
| sort(field=first, order=desc, limit=200)
ucs.rationale: INC Ransom's exfiltration playbook is unusually monomorphic across victim engagements documented by Huntress, SentinelOne, ReliaQuest and CISA: 7-Zip/WinRAR archives of mapped shares dropped to C:\Users\Public or C:\ProgramData, then shipped via MEGAsync / MEGAcmd / rclone to mega.nz. Most ransomware actors use Rclone-to-pCloud, MASS, AnyDesk-built-in transfers, or custom uploaders. The 7-Zip→MEGA

ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom WMIC /node: lateral execution pushing payload from public staging directories
ucs.description: Hunts INC Ransom's signature lateral-movement primitive — wmic.exe with /node:<remote> process call create invoking an executable from C:\Users\Public, C:\ProgramData, ADMIN$ or C$ shares. The crew repeatedly uses this WMI-driven push (instead of PsExec or Impacket) to deploy the .INC encryptor and supporting tooling across the estate after harvesting credentials from LSASS.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as first max(_time) as last values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" Processes.process="*/node:*" (Processes.process="*process call create*" OR Processes.process="*process create*") by Processes.dest Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "\$$") AND NOT match(user, "(?i)^(system|local service|network service)$") | rex field=cmdlines "(?i)/node:\"?(?<remote_node>[^\"\s,]+)" | rex field=cmdlines "(?i)process\s+call\s+create\s+\"?(?<remote_cmd>[^\"]+)\"?" | search remote_cmd="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR remote_cmd="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR remote_cmd="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR remote_cmd="*\\Temp\\*" OR remote_cmd="*ADMIN$*" OR remote_cmd="*\\\\*" OR remote_cmd="*.exe*" OR remote_cmd="*.bat*" OR remote_cmd="*.cmd*" OR remote_cmd="*.ps1*" | table first, last, dest, user, remote_node, remote_cmd, parent, cmdlines | sort - first
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName =~ "wmic.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "/node:"     // remote target — distinguishes lateral wmic from local mgmt
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("process call create","process create")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend RemoteNode = extract(@"(?i)/node:""?([^""\s,]+)""?", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend RemoteCmd  = extract(@"(?i)process\s+call\s+create\s+""?([^""]+)""?", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| where isnotempty(RemoteNode)
| where RemoteCmd has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Temp\", @"\\", "admin$", "c$")     // INC drops payload into world-writable / share paths
     or RemoteCmd matches regex @"(?i)\.(exe|bat|cmd|ps1|vbs|dll)(\s|$|"")"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteNode, RemoteCmd,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          FullWmicCmd = ProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\wmic.exe"
| where CommandLine has "/node:"
| where CommandLine has_any ("process call create","process create")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| extend RemoteNode = extract(@"(?i)/node:""?([^""\s,]+)""?", 1, CommandLine)
| extend RemoteCmd  = extract(@"(?i)process\s+call\s+create\s+""?([^""]+)""?", 1, CommandLine)
| where isnotempty(RemoteNode)
| where RemoteCmd has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Temp\", @"\\", "admin$", "c$")
     or RemoteCmd matches regex @"(?i)\.(exe|bat|cmd|ps1|vbs|dll)(\s|$|"")"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, RemoteNode, RemoteCmd,
          ParentProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: INC Ransom WMIC Remote Process Create From Public Staging Path
id: 1d3b6e2c-4a17-49f5-9c08-8f6b21a3b0e4
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects wmic.exe being invoked with /node: and a process call create that
  targets a payload sitting in C:\Users\Public, C:\ProgramData, \Windows\Temp
  or an ADMIN$ / C$ admin share. This is the canonical lateral-movement
  primitive INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) uses to spread the .INC encryptor and
  supporting tooling after credential theft from LSASS.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1047/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.lateral_movement
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1047
  - attack.t1021.002
  - attack.t1570
  - attack.g1032
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_wmic:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '/node:'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'process call create'
      - 'process create'
  selection_payload_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - 'ADMIN$'
      - 'C$'
      - '\\'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  filter_service_accts:
    User|contains:
      - 'SYSTEM'
      - 'LOCAL SERVICE'
      - 'NETWORK SERVICE'
  condition: selection_wmic and selection_payload_path and not (filter_machine_acct or filter_service_accts)
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned admin tooling using wmic for remote install (allowlist by source host / parent process)
  - SCCM / configuration-management push (allowlist by parent process such as ccmexec.exe)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"/node:"* AND (*"process call create"* OR *"process create"*)) @CommandLine:(*"\\Users\\Public\\"* OR *"\\ProgramData\\"* OR *"\\Windows\\Temp\\"* OR *"\\Temp\\"* OR *"ADMIN$"* OR *"\\\\"* OR *.exe* OR *.bat* OR *.cmd* OR *.ps1*) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR "LOCAL SERVICE" OR "NETWORK SERVICE")
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i CommandLine=/\/node:/i CommandLine=/process\s+(call\s+)?create/i
| regex("(?i)(\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\|\\\\ProgramData\\\\|\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\Temp\\\\|ADMIN\\$|\\\\\\\\|\\.(exe|bat|cmd|ps1|vbs|dll))", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| UserName!=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| RemoteNode := regex("(?i)/node:\"?(?<RemoteNode>[^\"\\s,]+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| RemoteCmd := regex("(?i)process\\s+call\\s+create\\s+\"?(?<RemoteCmd>[^\"]+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, RemoteNode], function={ count(), first := min(@timestamp), last := max(@timestamp), sample := selectFromMin(field=@timestamp, include=[RemoteCmd, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName]) })
| sort(field=first, order=desc, limit=200)
ucs.rationale: WMIC remote process create is documented in nearly every published INC Ransom incident write-up (Huntress, ReliaQuest, SentinelLABS, SOCRadar, CISA #StopRansomware AA24-241A on related INC/Lynx tooling). Where most modern crews prefer Impacket smbexec, Cobalt Strike jump psexec_psh, or BYOVD-driven service installs, INC operators repeatedly fall back on the LOLBin pattern `wmic /node:<host> proces
